desc.en: Badr is between the illuminated Medina and the Holy Mecca. Fourteen companions of the Holy Prophet (s) were martyred here in the Great Battle of Badr. There is Masjid-e-A’reesh near the martyrs of Badr. Perform two rakats prayer then recite the Ziyarat of the martyrs of Badr in the following manner…
desc.rurdu: Badr, Madina aur Makkeh ke darmiyaan mein hai. Rasool-e-Khuda (s) ke 14 sahaabi is azeem Jang-e-Badr mein shaheed huwe. Shohoda-e-Badr ke qareeb Masjid-e-Areesh hai jahan par 2 rakat namaz adaa kare aur phir ziyarat Shohoda-e-Badr is tarah se anjaam de…

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی رَسُوْلِ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی نَبِیِّ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلٰی اَھْلِ بَیْتِہِ الطَّاہِرِیْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ اَیُّہَا الشُّہَدَآئُ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَ۔ اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ یَا اَھْلَ بَیْتِ الْاِیْمَانِ وَالتَّوْحِیْدِ۔

lines.rarabic: ASSALAAMO A’LAA RASOOLIL LAAHE ASSALAAMO A’LAA NABIYYIL LAAHE ASSALAAMO A’LAA MOHAMMADIBN NE A’BDIL LAAHE ASSALAAMO A’LAA AHLE BAYTEHIT TAAHEREENA ASSALAAMO A’LAYKUM AYYOHASH SHOHADAAA-UL MOAMENOONA ASSALAAMO A’LAYKUM YAA AHLA BAYTIL EEMAANE WAT TAWHEEDE.

trans.en: Peace be on the Prophet of Allah, Peace be on the Messenger of Allah; Peace be on Muhammad the son of ‘Abd Allah’; Peace be on you, O people of the house of belief and unity; Peace be on you, O helpers of the religion of Allah and helpers of His Prophet and his family.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ یَا اَنْصَارَ دِیْنِ اللهِ وَاَنْصَارَ رَسُوْلِہٖ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْہِ وَآلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ سَلَامٌ عَلَیْكُمْ بِمَا صَبَرْتُمْ فَنِعْمَ عُقْبَی الدَّارِ۔ اَشْہَدُ اَنَّ اللهَ قَدِ اخْتَارَكُمْ لِدِیْنِہٖ وَاصْطَفَاكُمْ لِرَسُوْلِہٖ۔ وَاَشْہَدُ اَنَّكُمْ قَدْ جَاہَدْتُمْ فِیْ اللهِ حَقَّ جِہَادِہٖ وَنَصَرْتُمْ لِدِیْنِ اللهِ وَسُنَّۃِ رَسُوْلِہٖ وَجُدْتُمْ بِاَنْفُسِكُمْ دُوْنَہٗ۔

lines.rarabic: ASSALAAMO A’LAYKUM YAA ANSAARA DEENIL LAAHE WA ANSAARA RASOOLEHI SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI WA SALLAMA SALAAMUN A’LAYKUM BEMAA SABARTUM FA-NE’MA U’QBAD DAARE ASH-HADO ANNAL LAAHA QADIKH TAARAKUM LEDEENEHI WAS TAFAAKUM LERASOOLEHI WA ASH-HADO ANNAKUM QAD JAAHADTUM FIL LAAHE HAQQA JEHAADEHI WA NASARTUM LE-DEENIL LAAHE WA SUNNATE RASOOLEHI WA JUDTUM BE-ANFOSEKUM DOONAHU.

trans.en: Peace be on you for the patience which you have exercised for what a wonderful abode that is! I bear witness that Allah has chosen you for His religion and chosen you for His Prophet. I also bear witness that you truly strove for Allah and defended the religion of Allah and His Prophet and you gave yourselves for him.

arabic.text: وَاَشْہَدُ اَنَّكُمْ قُتِلْتُمْ عَلٰی مِنْہَاجِ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْہِ وَآلِہٖ وَسَلَّمَ فَجَزَاكُمُ اللهُ عَنْ نَبِیِّہٖ وَعَنِ الْاِسْلَامِ وَاَھْلِہٖ اَفْضَلَ الْجَزَآئِ وَعَرَّفَنَا فِیْ مَحَلِّ رِضْوَانِہٖ وَمَوْضِعِ اِكْرَامِہٖ مَعَ النَّبِیِّیْنَ وَالصِّدِّیْقِیْنَ وَالشُّہَدَآئِ وَالصَّالِحِیْنَ وَحَسُنَ اُوْلٰٓئِكَ رَفیْقًا۔

lines.rarabic: WA ASH-HADO ANNAKUM QOTILTUM A’LAA MINHAAJE RASOOLIL LAAHE SALLAL LAAHO A’LAYHE WA AALEHI WA SALLAMA FA-JA-ZAAKOMUL LAAHO A’N NABIYYEHI WA A’NIL ISLAAME WA AHLEHI AFZALAL JA-ZAAA-E WA A’RRAFANAA FEE MAHALLE RIZWAANEHI WA MAWZE-A’ IKRAAMEHI MA-A’N NABIYYEENA WAS SIDDEEQEENA WASH SHOHADAAA-E WAS SAALEHEENA WA HASONA OOLAAA-EKA RAFEEQAN.

trans.en: I bear witness that you were killed on the path of the Prophet of Allah so may Allah grant you the best reward of (your services to) His Prophet and for Islam and its followers. May Allah make us see your faces in places of His pleasure and His honor with the Messengers and the truthful ones and the martyrs and the upright ones; for they are the best friends.

arabic.text: اَشْہَدُ اَنَّكُمْ حِزْبُ اللهِ وَاَنَّ مَنْ حَارَبَكُمْ فَقَدْ حَارَبَ اللهُ وَاَنَّكُمْ لَمِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِیْنَ الْفَآئِزِیْنَ اَلَّذِیْنَ ہُمْ اَحْیَائٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّہِمْ یُرْزَقُوْنَ فَعَلٰی مَنْ قَتَلَكُمْ لَعْنَۃُ اللهِ وَالْمَلَآئِكَۃِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجْمَعِیْنَ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكُمْ وَرَحْمَۃُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَاتُہٗ۔

lines.rarabic: ASH-HADO ANNAKUM HIZBUL LAAHE WA ANNA MAN HAARABAKUM FAQAD HAARABAL LAAHO WA ANNAKUM LEMANIL MOQARRABEENAL FAAA-EZEENA ALLAZEENA HUM AHYAA-UN I’NDA RABBEHIM YURZAQOONA FA-A’LAA MAN QATALAKUM LA’NATUL LAAHE WAL MALAAA-EKATE WAN NAASE AJMA-E’ENA WAS SALAAMO A’LAYKUM WA RAHMATUL LAAHE WA BARAKAATOHU.

trans.en: I bear witness that you are the party of Allah and that one who wages war against you wages war against Allah. I also bear witness that you are the close, victorious ones to Allah who are living in the proximity of their Lord and are being nourished. May the curse of Allah and the angels and all the people fall on those who killed you and may the peace, mercy and blessings of Allah be upon you all.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
